controls.procedure: Parse normative Markdown list items without depending on an opening-verb allowlist, then independently compare source-line tuples against the requirement closure and fail when one item disappears.
controls.expected: Every normative list item reaches the closure, explicit non-normative sections remain excluded, and independent detection blocks any silent omission.
controls.observed: Focused prevention and independent-detection fixtures passed for Portuguese and English normative sections, and the current issue snapshot now yields 18 covered obligations including the four formerly omitted list items.
